title: Account Manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Account Manager em campo grande. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Key Account Manager – Car Rental In this role, you will be responsible for: Managing the sales performance of the car rental portfolio, identifying opportunities to increase revenue. Negotiating commercial agreements, commissions, and rates with key accounts to ensure competitiveness and market growth. Monitoring availability, rate parity, and partner performance across our channels, ensuring the best customer experience. Analyzing market data, product performance, and KPIs to identify business opportunities and performance improvements. Developing commercial strategies in partnership with Marketing, Product, and Finance teams to increase conversion and revenue. Prospecting and developing new partnerships aligned with the company’s expansion strategy. Tracking partner performance indicators (availability, rate parity, NPS, SLA, among others) and driving continuous improvement. Representing the company at events and strengthening relationships with strategic partners. What we expect from you (experience, soft and hard skills): Experience in a service-based company, preferably in the car rental industry. Advanced negotiation skills in challenging situations, seeking innovative and win‑win solutions. Emotional intelligence in interactions, especially in sensitive negotiations, maintaining a collaborative and constructive environment. Ability to collaborate with cross‑functional teams, ensuring alignment to achieve shared goals. Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills. Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, is confident in driving results, constantly solves problems, and engages colleagues to achieve goals. Key Account Manager / Implementation Lead – Software Solutions Position Overview: We’re looking for a motivated Key Account Manager / Implementation Lead who will serve as both a relationship builder and implementation expert. In this role, you’ll be the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring our software solutions align with their needs and integrate seamlessly into their operations. This fully remote role combines client engagement with hands‑on deployment, offering the opportunity to be directly involved in both client satisfaction and product success. Responsibilities: Client Relationship Management: Cultivate strong, lasting relationships with key clients, ensuring they feel supported and valued. Primary Point of Contact: Serve as the primary liaison for assigned accounts, providing responsive and reliable client support. Implementation Planning: Develop, document, and manage comprehensive implementation plans, including client‑specific requirements, configurations, and any necessary customizations. Data Specification Documentation: Prepare technical specifications and manage electronic data interface (EDI) setup with clients for seamless integration. Deployment Leadership: Lead software implementations at client locations as required, managing deployment to ensure successful integration and operation. Client Collaboration: Work closely with clients to thoroughly understand their project requirements and guarantee successful software adoption. Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Deliver hands‑on technical support during the implementation phase, addressing issues quickly to maintain satisfaction. Client Training: Educate clients and their teams on using our software effectively, enabling them to gain maximum benefit from the tools. Feedback Loop with Development: Collaborate closely with the product development team, sharing field insights and client feedback to support ongoing product improvements. Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. Industry Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in the construction industry. Technical Interest: Strong interest in construction technology and software solutions. Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for effective client engagement and support. Problem‑Solving Abilities: A detail‑oriented approach with a proactive problem‑solving mindset. Multi‑Project Management: Capability to manage multiple client accounts or projects simultaneously. Willingness to Travel: Availability to travel to client sites as necessary. Preferred Qualifications Advanced Work Packaging (AWP): Familiarity with AWP methodologies. Software Knowledge: Experience with construction management software or related technology. Implementation Process Insight: Basic understanding of software implementation processes. Client‑Facing Experience: Previous experience in a client‑focused role or account management. Remote Work: Fully remote position with flexibility and some overlap required with U.S. working hours. Autonomous Drive: Proactive, creative, and capable of driving projects forward independently. Hands‑on Approach: Eager to engage with both client challenges and technical solutions directly. Compensation: Salary: Competitive salary starting at $55,000/year. Benefits: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits. Growth Opportunities: Paths for professional development and career advancement within the company. Culture: A collaborative, inclusive, and innovation‑driven workplace that values teamwork and individual initiative. Business Development Manager – Temu Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Manager to join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry. Responsibilities Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs. Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth. Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies. Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance. Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends. Required skills / Minimum Qualifications 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations. Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus. Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions. Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans. Excellent problem‑solving skills, self‑motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes. Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high‑demand periods. Equal Employment Statement At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity. Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Marketing designer
description:

AI Marketing Designer Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours A letter from our client Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way. Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them. Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products. In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done. Why this role exists Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack. The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck. They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships. The role This position is equal parts: AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong. On the AI side: Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, Chat GPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill. On the design and development side: The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, Git Hub, and AI-assisted coding workflows. The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance. Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate. What the role includes Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency What our client is looking for Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, Chat GPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using Git Hub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset What they DO NOT want Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt Portfolio required Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application. Their team would like to see: At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow What it's like working with them They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence. There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time. If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

Diagnosticar e tratar transtornos mentais (depressão, ansiedade, transtorno bipolar, transtornos alimentares, TDAH, entre outros). Prescrever medicamentos e outras formas de tratamento, como psicoterapia. Acompanhar a evolução dos pacientes e realizar ajustes no tratamento conforme necessário. Orientar familiares e cuidadores. Participar de reuniões de equipe e atividades de educação continuada. Manter-se atualizado sobre os avanços da área. Modelo de contratação Contratação PJ por plantão de 12 horas (8h às 20h). Valor do plantão: R$ 3.400,00. O que oferecemos Trabalho 100% remoto, com escolha dos dias de plantão conforme disponibilidade. Acesso a ferramentas tecnológicas proprietárias de suporte clínico. Equipe multidisciplinar colaborativa e focada em inovação. Atuação em contextos institucionais de impacto. title: Customer success manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Customer success manager em campo grande. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B) About Sisense Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (An Paa S) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action. The Role As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance. Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense's growth in embedded AI analytics. About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning. Requirements 3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions. How You'll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals. What We Offer Employment through a partner agency (B2 B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

Nossa energia vai além do negócio: está nas pessoas e no nosso jeito de ser. Com capacidade para abastecer mais de 60 milhões de carros com etanol, adoçar milhões de festas com nosso açúcar e levar energia para o bem-estar de mais de 20 milhões de pessoas, também somos destaque na emissão de CBIOs. Atuamos com responsabilidade, desenvolvendo comunidades, cuidando do meio ambiente e transformando vidas. Aqui na Atvos lideramos a transição energética para mover o mundo e transformar vidas. Confira mais da nossa empresa pelo site: #Vem Pra Atvos Aqui, diversidade é essencial! Nossas vagas são destinadas a todos, com incentivo á participação de mulheres e PCDs. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Liderar e supervisionar projetos civis de grande porte e alta complexidade, garantindo qualidade técnica, cumprimento de prazos e gestão eficiente de orçamento. Definir e acompanhar escopos, cronogramas e custos, monitorando o andamento dos projetos e realizando ajustes quando necessário. Desenvolver estratégias e planos de engenharia alinhados às normas técnicas, regulatórias e às diretrizes corporativas. Conduzir análises de viabilidade, estudos de impacto e avaliações técnicas para assegurar eficiência e conformidade dos projetos. Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares (engenharia civil, arquitetura, infraestrutura e áreas correlatas), promovendo integração e solução de problemas. Supervisionar fornecedores e contratados, garantindo a aderência a requisitos técnicos, padrões de qualidade e prazos de entrega. Implementar práticas de controle de qualidade, realizar auditorias internas e assegurar conformidade com normas de segurança. Identificar riscos, desenvolver estratégias de mitigação e propor soluções técnicas inovadoras diante de cenários adversos. Manter comunicação contínua com stakeholders internos e externos, elaborando relatórios técnicos e de progresso para diferentes níveis da organização. Desenvolver e orientar profissionais da área, promovendo aprimoramento técnico e fortalecimento das competências do time. Requisitos e qualificações: Formação em Engenharia Civil. Experiência sólida liderando projetos civis de grande porte e alta complexidade. Experiência em gestão de equipes, liderança técnica e tomada de decisão em contextos desafiadores. Forte capacidade de comunicação, negociação e relacionamento com áreas internas e externas. Habilidade para conduzir múltiplos projetos simultaneamente. Perfil estratégico, analítico, inovador e orientado a resultados. Domínio avançado de softwares de engenharia civil, ferramentas de análise estrutural, gerenciamento de projetos e controle de qualidade. Informações adicionais: Vaga presencial para a nossa unidade de Nova Alvorada do Sul/MS. Oferecemos pacote de mudança. Benefícios que fortalecem nossa energia Na Atvos, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é essencial para transformar o amanhã. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar seu bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida dentro e fora do campo ou do escritório. Se você acredita em um futuro movido por energia limpa e por gente que faz a diferença, vem transformar o amanhã com a gente.

title: Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd
description:
Confira a vaga para Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd em campo grande. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a Service Now Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress. EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices; Profile: Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA); Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

title: Analista de manutenção complementar - sênior
description:
Empresa está contratando Analista de manutenção complementar - sênior em campo grande. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Sobre a Arauco Brasil No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera. Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade. Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Desafios Suportar as atividades de manutenção complementar, tais como: elevação e movimentação de cargas, civil, refratários, revestimento anticorrosivo, andaimes, pintura industrial, isolamento térmico, hidrojateamento, elevadores e etc. Atuar na gestão de contratos de prestação de serviços e/ou equipes próprias distribuindo, controlando e orientando as diversas tarefas, para apoiar e assegurar estrategicamente a manutenção preditiva, preventiva e corretiva, garantindo a confiabilidade, segurança e eficiência dos processos industriais. Apoiar e/ou conduzir desenvolvimento de estudos técnicos visando à redução dos custos operacionais (Operação e Manutenção) e introdução de novas tecnologias. Atividades Principais: Garantir a efetiva aplicação dos procedimentos do sistema da qualidade e ferramentas do modelo organizacional nas áreas operacionais de produção, bem como, na adequada conscientização, orientação, revisão e treinamento das práticas pelas equipes de trabalho. Contribuir, continuamente na formação técnica, na postura pró-ativa e multidisciplinar das equipes, conscientizando-as da necessidade de um efetivo comprometimento em relação a princípios de qualidade, produtividade e melhoria contínua. Garantir a efetiva interface com as áreas de apoio da empresa, bem como com fornecedores e empresas terceirizadas. Elaborar escopos de contratação de serviços terceirizados de manutenção, participando ativamente das etapas de negociação e avaliação técnica, assegurando as melhores práticas, custos adequados, qualidade, segurança e a confiabilidade em todo o processo; Gerenciar serviços e fornecedores, fiscalizando qualidade, prazos, medições, relatórios e etc. Elaborar pareceres técnicos, instruções de trabalho, procedimentos e padrões de montagem/ajuste específicos para a unidade; Pesquisar e analisar a viabilidade de implementação de novas tecnologias e metodologias aplicados nas reformas de manutenção em oficina ou em campo que possam aumentar a confiabilidade e a eficiência dos equipamentos e/ou dos métodos de trabalho; Trabalhar em conjunto com Suprimentos e Engenharia de Confiabilidade para avaliar o desempenho de componentes críticos e propor a padronização ou substituição por outros de maior durabilidade e confiabilidade, baseando-se em análises técnicas e de custo-benefício; Realizar pesquisas de benchmarking com outras empresas ou indústrias equivalentes para identificar as melhores práticas em manutenção complementar e propor a sua adaptação e implementação na fábrica; Colaborar com a Engenharia de Confiabilidade na análise do ciclo de vida de equipamentos, fornecendo insights técnicos sobre a viabilidade de reformas vs. substituições, considerando custos de manutenção acumulados, criticidade e tecnologias disponíveis; Trabalhar em conjunto com o Almoxarifado e Suprimentos para otimizar o estoque de sobressalentes de componentes, garantindo a disponibilidade de itens críticos sem incorrer em custos excessivos de capital parado; Auxiliar na gestão dos custos das funções complementares, realizando a previsão do orçamento anual de (Spend e Headcount), incluindo custos de materiais, mão de obra e outros recursos, assim como, acompanhar mensalmente os custos realizados, alocando corretamente nas contas contábeis, apresentando e validando com o gestor imediato durante as reuniões de análise crítica, visando o cumprimento do orçamento e otimização dos custos; Trabalhar em colaboração com o time de engenharia, produção e segurança, apoiando e executando projetos de melhorias, inovação, modificações e modernização de instalações, máquinas e equipamentos, normas e planos de manutenção, identificando causa raiz, apresentando soluções corretivas e preventivas, evitando recorrências, otimizando custos e aumentando a disponibilidade das máquinas e equipamentos; Treinar e orientar tecnicamente os times de manutenção, nos procedimentos e melhores práticas, promovendo a melhoria contínua das habilidades e conhecimento, bem como, assegurando que o time esteja treinado e capacitado para assumir as atividades de manutenção após o startup da planta, disponibilizando ferramentas, recursos técnicos e humanos para apoiar os fornecedores dos equipamentos e tecnologias; Participar ativamente do processo de planejamento e execução da Paradas Gerais e Setoriais da planta, realizando o mapeamento das atividades de manutenção, através de alinhamento com a gerência de produção, mitigando os riscos e impactos gerados, desenvolvendo estratégias e plano de ação, avaliando e desenvolvendo fornecedores e prestadores de serviço, sempre prezando pela segurança e otimização dos custos; Implantar, monitorar e analisar diariamente os indicadores de desempenho da sua área de atuação (Custos, disponibilidade, produtividade, estoque de peças de reposição etc.), viabilizando ajustes no planejamento, procedimentos e nos processos; Cumprir, fazer cumprir e promover os padrões de segurança e regulamentações aplicadas às pessoas e aos equipamentos, através da realização de avaliação de riscos e implantação de medidas, alinhas à gestão; Zelar pela organização e limpeza das áreas de atuação utilizando ferramentas como 5 S garantindo que todo o processo seja implementado, conhecido e aplicado pelo time de manutenção, sejam eles próprios ou terceirizados; title: Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd
description:

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a Service Now Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress. EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices; Profile: Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA); Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;
